# HolyCrab Agent Tools v0.4.4

This release fixes installation choices and recovery during updates.

- Fresh installations include the CLI and Codex/Claude Skills. Reinstallation and updates preserve the existing Agent and MCP choices, including installations without Agent integration.
- The installer also understands blank settings sent by older updaters and recovers the previous choice from the installation record.
- All downloaded and local-source files are verified using SHA-256 before execution or replacement. Windows DPAPI credential protection is retained.
- Failed updates report bounded, sanitized installer diagnostics. Missing or inconsistent installation records stop an update before it changes files.
- Recovery restores only managed files changed by the installer, including its HolyCrab MCP changes. Unselected Skills and unrelated files are retained. Incomplete recovery keeps the backup and reports its location.
- No public commands, parameters or MCP tools are added. API Keys, attempts and user state are preserved during normal installation and uninstallation.
- Online health checks distinguish an optional, never-configured Agent from a broken managed connection. Connection repairs point to the installer rather than a no-op version update.

## Installation and update

Users with an updater can run `holycrab update`. Users on v0.4.0 can run the installer again. Always use the matching Windows or macOS/Linux installation instructions.

The v0.4.3 tag and assets remain immutable. v0.4.4 replaces it as the recommended version only after release checks pass.

## Verification

Publication requires the full regression suite, native installation checks, release digests and the v0.4.4 acceptance record. Generate is checked against synchronized local main. Real-person production commands are excluded at the user's request and will be manually checked after release.

The authorized live test uses one image, one video and one audio generation, plus up to three ordinary image uploads. Their actual outcomes and cost evidence are recorded in the acceptance report; tests and mocks are not installed on users' computers.
